verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own REST API exposes 'much of the data in the system' and is documented as a way to 'get data out to integrate with other systems', including paginated item listing. That gives a programmatic path to extract data, but it is not a documented export feature, and coverage is explicitly 'much', not all. missing for 10: dedicated bulk or full-account export, confirmation that all data types (occurrences, replays, settings) are exportable in open formats, documented account deletion/offboarding, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.
